papers.t: Polydopamine-modified biochar supported polylactic acid and zero-valent iron affects the functional microbial community structure for 1,1,1-trichloroethane removal in simulated groundwater
Biochar-based composite microspheres embedded with zero-valent iron and soybean oil efficiently remove 1,1,1-trichloroethane and reshape microbial community in simulated groundwater
